name: Creotech Instruments S.A.
summary: Creotech Instruments S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of satellites, satellite systems, and subsystems in Poland. The company offers satellites, such as Nano MR MS, Eagle HR MS, and Seagull HR SAR; platforms, including HyperSat Nano, HyperSat Eagle, and custom solutions; and various services comprising mission analysis and design, registration, insurance, launch, operations, data warehousing, processing, and advanced data analysis services.
